function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Sure thing! Here’s a quick guide to help you find the perfect place to order a cake from—whether you’re looking for something local, a specialty shop, or just want it delivered right to your door.

---

### 1️⃣ Local Bakeries & Specialty Shops  
These places often offer fresh, artisanal cakes and sometimes even custom designs.

| Option | What Makes Them Great | How to Order |
|--------|----------------------|--------------|
| **Your Neighborhood Bakery** | Freshly baked, personalized service | Call or visit their website; many accept phone orders |
| **Specialty Cake Shop** (e.g., “The Sweet Spot” or “Cake Couture”) | Custom decorations, themed cakes | Book online via their site or call ahead for design consultations |
| **Farm‑to‑Table Bakery** | Organic ingredients, seasonal flavors | Check their menu online; place orders through their ordering portal |

> *Tip:* Look for bakeries that have good Yelp or Google reviews, especially those that highlight quality and customer service.

---

### 2️⃣ Online Delivery Platforms  
If you want convenience and a wide selection, try one of these apps/websites:

| Platform | Why It Works | How to Find Cakes |
|----------|--------------|-------------------|
| **Uber Eats / DoorDash / Grubhub** | Huge network of restaurants + bakeries | Search “cake” or “dessert” in the app; filter by rating |
| **Instacart** | Grocery plus bakery items | Add a local grocery store that carries cakes; they’ll deliver |
| **Amazon Fresh** | Fast delivery, reliable packaging | Browse “cakes” under groceries; choose same‑day delivery if available |
| **Postmates** | Flexible pickup/delivery times | Search “bakery” or “cake”; see real‑time availability |

> *Pro Tip:* Many platforms let you see photos, read reviews, and even chat with the seller directly before placing an order.

---

### 3️⃣ Big Box Stores & Supermarkets  
Convenient if you’re already shopping nearby.

| Store | What to Look For | Ordering Method |
|-------|------------------|-----------------|
| **Whole Foods** | Organic options, custom orders | Visit the bakery counter or use the Whole Foods app |
| **Walmart** | Affordable, ready‑made cakes | Pick up at the bakery section or order online for curbside pickup |
| **Target** | Trendy flavors, seasonal specials | Check Target’s online grocery section for cake options |

---

### 4️⃣ Specialty Dessert Chains  
Great for consistent quality and brand recognition.

| Chain | Signature Offerings | Ordering |
|-------|---------------------|----------|
| **Baker & Spice** | Classic French pastries, custom cakes | Order online or call the nearest outlet |
| **Cinnabon** | Cinnamon rolls, mini cakes | Place an order via their app for pickup or delivery |
| **Dunkin’ Donuts** | Quick dessert options, occasional cake specials | Use Dunkin’ app for easy ordering |

---

### 5️⃣ Tips for a Smooth Cake Order  

| Step | Detail |
|------|--------|
| **Check Delivery Times** | Make sure the delivery window fits your event schedule. |
| **Ask About Customization** | If you need a specific flavor, size, or decoration, confirm they can accommodate. |
| **Confirm Packaging** | Ask how the cake will be packaged to ensure safe transport. |
| **Read Reviews** | Look for comments about freshness, taste, and delivery reliability. |
| **Consider Dietary Needs** | Specify allergies or preferences (gluten‑free, vegan, nut‑free). |

---

#### Quick Action List

1. **Decide Your Style** – Classic chocolate, modern fusion, custom design?
2. **Choose a Vendor** – Local bakery for freshness, or a delivery platform for convenience.
3. **Place the Order Early** – Especially if you need a custom design or special occasion.
4. **Double‑check Details** – Confirm delivery address, time, and any special instructions.

Happy cake hunting! 🎂🍰 Let me know if you’d like me to look up specific bakeries in your city or compare prices for a particular style.
